job_description:
Customer Success Manager

Join our customer organization to help mid-market customers realize value from a workflow SaaS platform. You will guide onboarding and adoption, identify renewal risks, and bring customer feedback into product decisions.

Basic Qualifications
- 3+ years in customer success, account management, or a comparable customer-facing SaaS role.
- Experience leading customer onboarding, adoption planning, and quarterly business reviews.
- Experience managing customer health and renewal risk in Salesforce or a comparable CRM.
- Strong cross-functional communication with product and support teams.
- Hands-on experience with HubSpot.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience improving customer enablement or training programs.
- Experience using product-usage analytics to guide adoption.
- Professional French-language customer communication.
